Anna (eng-security): Quick preflight for the May fieldwork window — need owners for a few items: auditlog ingest proof, keystore stub, HSM attestation smoke. Fieldwork starts 2026-05-12. Can owners pls ack? (cc @ops-bot for slot reservation)

Sam K: I'll take auditlog ingest evidence for prod->staging. Will open checklist PR by EOD. ETA for evidence artifacts: 2026-05-07.

Nate - infra: I can do keystore stub + staging smoke, but need help from Mike on HSM network policies. Will schedule a short sync.

Mike L: Ack. I can do the HSM policy review early next week. Ping me Monday with specifics. Also which HSM vendor?

Sasha D - compliance: For SOC2 fieldwork we need the envelope-key rotation proof + runbook link. Anna can you confirm the runbook path?

Anna (eng-security): Runbook is at https://redwood.internal/docs/keystore/runbooks/rotation.md. ACTIONS: Sam -> PR #1428 for auditlog; Nate -> keystore stub branch 'keystore-stub/fieldwork'; Mike -> HSM policy draft; Sasha -> prepare evidence checklist template. @ops-bot reserve 2x fieldwork slots 2026-05-12/13.

ops-bot: Reserved slots 2026-05-12 14:00 and 2026-05-13 09:00 in audit-calendar. Link: https://calendar.internal/slots/541234

Sam K: PR opened -> https://git.internal/redwood/audit-evidence/pulls/1428. Summary: includes log retention proof + replay script. Need a quick review from Nate or Anna.

Nate - infra: Reviewing now, leaving inline comment re: replay script env vars. @Mike L can you confirm HSM network ACL rules allow replay host?

Mike L: I'll check and update ACLs. Quick note — staging HSM is behind firewall rule fw-sg-23.

Sasha D - compliance: Small ask — can we include a brief timeline in PRs: when evidence was generated + who signed off? That helps auditors.

Anna (eng-security): Good call. Add a md note in PR template. Also high-level: if anything blocks, escalate here. Thanks all.
